title: 2026-11-16-ops-business-menu-m3c
goal: Restructure pantheon-ops business navigation into parent-plus-children (M+3C) menus for the bizscope and service modules, aligning the frontend defineModule registry, backend menu seeds, i18n, the business overlay component registry, the derived migration chain, and smoke specs. Adds the per-scope environment catalog (biz_business_environment) and retires the flat /business/service page for /business/service-catalog/*.

in: bizscope: keep 业务域 list as parent; add 主机绑定 (HostBinding) and 环境管理 (EnvironmentList/EnvironmentForm) children
service: parent 服务目录 + children 应用/服务/服务实例 under /business/service-catalog/*; ServiceCatalog deep-links its active tab from the route and the /business/service page is retired
backend: per-scope environment CRUD routes /business/bizscope/:id/environments and biz_business_environment migration (dev/test/prod, unique scope+code)
menu seeds, permissions, i18n seeds, business-overlay component registry, and the 000040 migration copy into the runtime derived chain
close a pre-existing en-US fallback gap: add 5 missing cmdb.host / deploy.package bundle keys
out: pantheon-base shared-path changes or a foundation release upgrade
regenerating the committed authoritative i18n fallback bundles

implementationNotes: The committed i18n fallback bundle (src/i18n/resources/business/*.ts) is the authoritative ground truth for the M+3C key set and must not be regenerated; new pages reuse existing committed keys.
Landing side stays in pantheon-ops because the behavior is confined to business/* modules and repo-local business docs/locales/smoke.
The per-scope environment routes and the service catalog tab deep-link are the smallest faithful realization of the committed key set.

commands: npx tsc -b && npx eslint . && npm run build
runtimeEvidence: GitHub pull_request workflows for quality and security gates
service page smoke spec and smoke-sanity suite in repository
local runtime gap note for rendered smokes not executed in a dirty-tree session

evidenceRequired: backend build and bizscope/service/menu test output
completionChecklist: per-scope environment migration in the derived chain
